future_probe.fit: ridge on stored timepool[final LN, tubelets 4-7] averaged over steps, probe clips (folds 3-4), alpha by 2-fold CV on those folds

predictor_ceiling.note: the predictor's own forecast for the real twin context, projected on the real twin-minus-source future change: the most an edit of the context can be expected to recover through this predictor

definitions.R_pred: <z_edit - z_src, z_twin_pred - z_src> / ||.||^2 on all 1024 predicted future tokens; z_twin_pred = the predictor's forecast from the rendered twin's context (like for like)
definitions.R_real: spec §6.5 literal: target = the twin's real future tokens (encoder, full 16-frame twin, post-LN); includes the predictor's own error in the denominator
definitions.R_realdiff: <z_edit - z_src, f_twin - f_src> / ||f_twin - f_src||^2 with f = real future tokens: predicted change against the real change (predictor bias cancels)
definitions.*_disk: same, restricted to future tokens where the source or the twin disk is (disk mask union)
definitions.shuffled_target: edit toward target j scored against the twin of target (j+1) mod T
definitions.context: frames 1-8 encoded alone (tokens 0..1023), edit added to every context token at layer L, predictor forecasts tubelets 4..7; edits were computed from the full-clip meanpool at L
